appraisal_events.evidence: le moment où se déchaîna cet enthousiasme du public, fut, je l'ai su depuis, celui où la Berma a une de ses plus belles trouvailles
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite the narrator's prolonged failure to perceive her greatness during the performance, the passage closes with a retrospective, narrator-endorsed confirmation that the crowd's outburst coincided with a genuinely brilliant moment in Berma's acting.

appraisal_events.evidence: vivait dans l'effervescence de la création... elle allait elle-même aux Halles se faire donner les plus beaux carrés... comme Michel-Ange passant huit mois dans les montagnes de Carrare à choisir les blocs de marbre les plus parfaits pour le monument de Jules II
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates Françoise's cooking for the dinner through an extended mock-epic comparison to Michelangelo, treating her culinary labor and devotion as genuine artistic creation.

status_effects.explanation: After an extended stretch of disappointment and doubt, the passage locally settles on a narrator-confirmed moment of genuine artistic brilliance for Berma.
Her culinary preparations for the Norpois dinner are framed with comic-heroic admiration, elevating her as a devoted and gifted artisan.

ambiguities: Most of the passage's meditation on La Berma's performance is essayistic and deliberately uncertain about whether admiration reflects genuine artistic perception or contagious crowd enthusiasm (the narrator explicitly notes applause 'tombaient le plus souvent à faux'); only the narrator's explicit retrospective validation at the very end was scored, per conservative treatment of layered irony.

Norpois's courteous reception and curious examination of le narrateur at the passage's close (he rises, shakes hands, studies him attentively) could be read as staging the narrator's brief inclusion in valued company, but this scene chiefly serves to characterize Norpois's habitual manner (already covered by the accepted annotation) and was judged to give the narrator no sufficiently distinct local outcome of his own, so it was left unscored.
